settings.title: Real people. Real results.
settings.body: Verified reviews from the barre, Pilates, and Lagree floor.

I have tried several brands of grips socks. The grip wears off, my toes slip and my Pilates form suffers. Since I have started use the barreletics grip shoes, those days are gone. I know have more confidence in my poses and the grip is consistent. Not to mention they are easy to put on and easy to wash. The mesh bag that they come in is very useful. It is big enough to hold my grip gloves for easy storing and transportation to class.
settings.author: Leslie S.

settings.body: These grippy shoes are the best most comfortable footwear for my barre and palates classes. I love them

settings.body: All grip and no slip, i love them i have neuropathy in my feet and cant keep grip socks on they slide off this is the best grip for me. I love them. I got open sole perfect fit.
